content.question: Explain how the temperature parameter affects sampling and when you would use low versus high temperature.
content.answer: Temperature divides the logits before softmax. T < 1 sharpens the distribution, making output more deterministic and repetitive; T > 1 flattens it, making output more diverse and creative but riskier. Low temperature suits factual, closed tasks (translation, code); high temperature suits creative or brainstorming tasks.
